recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Treat any future concern about MedicinalProductDefinition.code as a specific code-vs-CodeableConcept modeling question, not as an unapplied FHIR-26460 migration item.
issue_request: FHIR-26460 was a Published/Persuasive BRR R5 change request to change Coding elements in medication definition resources to CodeableConcept unless there was a good reason not to.
initial_application: Five March 2020 FHIR-26460 commits changed the affected medication-definition spreadsheet sources for SubstanceDefinition, PackagedProductDefinition, MedicinalProductDefinition, AdministrableProductDefinition, and ManufacturedItemDefinition; those commits are contained in the R5 history.
additional_context: The source was later reworked into StructureDefinition XML. Current fhir.ini entries show the relevant successor resources and old MedicinalProduct* redirects are in build scope. FHIR-31794, a later Published/Persuasive with Modification issue, explicitly added MedicinalProductDefinition.code as Coding 0..* alongside identifier, and its audit commit is already on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because changing MedicinalProductDefinition.code to CodeableConcept would conflict with the later, more specific FHIR-31794 decision, while the other target resources have no remaining bare Coding types.

related_jiras.note: Later Published BRR decision explicitly added MedicinalProductDefinition.code as Coding 0..* alongside identifier; it is already represented by commit b22faf4d10cc76f807013099a1a1c60b5634926e on the combined branch.
